worldcombat.skill.spicyextract.summary: Releases an intensely spicy extract. The target's Attack rises sharply and its Defence falls sharply.
worldcombat.skill.spicyextract.use.0: Open a focus-fire window for your whole team
worldcombat.skill.spicyextract.use.1: Turn a tank into a glass cannon
worldcombat.skill.spicyextract.use.2: Scorch a small cluster in a tight space
worldcombat.skill.spicyextract.descripti: Hurl the extract at a point: every enemy within the burst gains %1$s Attack stages and loses %2$s Defence stages; the single body the bottle hits directly can be an ally, who receives the same double-edged boost on purpose. The payoff belongs to everyone attacking it, and nothing here deals damage.

The haze has a %1$s-block radius and lingers about %2$s s, filtering enemies only; enemies who walk in are scorched once (each target resolves once per haze, and those already hit by the burst are not stacked again).
The bottle flies at %1$s blocks/tick with a %2$s-block hit radius over a %3$s-block range; it can be deflected or blocked by cover, and bursts on the surface it strikes.

Telegraph %1$s s, recovery %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s. Concentration options: neat extract bursts up close on one target for the deepest window; diluted spray reaches further and covers a small cluster, but each dose is milder.
worldcombat.skill.spicyextract.timing: Short windup and recovery; one throw with an area resolution, paced by its cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.spicyextract.preferenc: Neat extract bursts up close on one target for the deepest window, but puts you in danger; diluted spray reaches further and covers a small cluster, but each dose is milder.
Only consider throwing a threat within this distance; larger opens earlier.
Prefer throwing when at least this many enemies stand near the target; 1 means throw whenever one is visible.
When on, the companion leaves its post to throw.
worldcombat.skill.spicyextract.descripti: The Attack and Defence stage changes stay until stages are cleared or the target leaves combat; the whole move deals no damage, only changing Attack and Defence.
